title: Rabbi Abba of Haifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him only in [Shabbat 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.45b.9), where Rabbi Abba and Rabbi Assi came to visit him.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Shabbat 45b explicitly writes Rabbi Abba and Rabbi Assi visiting Rabbi Abba of Haifa.

[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=22&lang=en) records the same visit by Rabbi Abba and Rabbi Assi to Rabbi Abba of Haifa. He questions a separate claim that the host was Rabbi Yochanan’s student. In the linked Gemara it is the visiting Rabbi Assi who is described as Rabbi Yochanan’s student.
